title: Clear joypad touchpad info after disconnecting
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

This PR fixes a bug where the joypad touchpad info doesn't get cleared after the joypad gets disconnected, which lead to bugs such as `Input.get_joy_num_touchpads()` returning `1` even if the joypad is disconnected or it doesn't have touchpads at all.

How to reproduce the bug on `master`:
1. Connect a controller with a touchpad (DualShock 4/DualSense controllers), notice that `Input.get_joy_num_touchpads()` returns `1`
2. Disconnect it, notice that `Input.get_joy_num_touchpads()` still returns `1` even though the controller is disconnected
3. Connect a controller without a touchpad, notice that `Input.get_joy_num_touchpads()` still returns `1`

I can confirm this change fixes the issue for me on Windows with my DualShock 4 controller.

- The bug was originally reported in https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/pull/1354

## Additional information

No AI was used.
